headline: IIFL Capital Services receives improved ESG rating from Crisil for FY2026
summary: Crisil ESG Ratings has voluntarily assigned IIFL Capital Services an ESG rating of 69 for FY2026, up from 63 in FY2024-25. The company also received a Core ESG rating of 74 based on FY2026 disclosures and public information. For an Indian retail investor, ESG score improvements reflect better corporate governance and sustainability practices, though the rating is voluntary and routine.
why_it_matters: Higher governance scores can attract ESG-focused institutional capital over time.
